sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. A single male military bust with short glossy black hair neatly side-parted and swept backward, small gray temple streaks, and dark gently arched brows. Upper lip, cheeks and chin are visibly smooth without a separate moustache or beard; no hat or eyewear. Slight screen-left head turn with eyes close to the viewer, closed lips and a serious composed expression. Dark olive-gray military tunic with a closed high standing collar, narrow pale blue-gray inner neckline rim, gold shoulder boards with red edging, a round gold front button and a small slanting red-and-pale bar immediately above that button. Preserve the collar closure and contact, shoulder-board placement and that small central bar. Upper chest and both shoulders are cut by the bottom/side edges; hair is entirely inside the canvas. Soft highlights on upper forehead and screen-left cheek, deeper shadow below the jaw and at screen-right. Pale cream-gray painted backing fills the whole rectangle and darkens toward the bottom. No card frame, note, exterior cutout or writing. Exact156x210 original and full nearest6 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: shoulder-board interior ornament and the tiny central bar have visible broad colors/shapes but no reliably readable emblem, lettering or rank detail. Actual source alpha249..255 is retained as measured under visible-alpha-v1; backing remains visibly continuous.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single male military bust wearing a tall soft gray-olive cap with a short dark visor and a narrow pale silvery horizontal band above the visor; the cap crown meets and is clipped by the top edge. Short dark side hair is visible below the cap at the temples, with modest dark brows. Smooth upper lip/chin with no separate moustache or beard, no eyewear. Nearly frontal upright head and near-forward gaze, relaxed closed lips and a quiet serious expression. Plain olive-gray tunic with a closed high standing collar, narrow pale blue-white inner neckline rim, center seam and smooth shoulders; no distinct medals or shoulder insignia are visible in this crop. Preserve the closed collar and natural cloth contact. Bust/shoulders meet the lower and side crop. Soft upper screen-left light, shadow beneath the visor and jaw, pale cream-gray painted backing darker at the lower sides across the entire canvas. No card frame, note, exterior cutout or writing. Exact156x210 original and full nearest6 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: cap surface creases, seam stitching and pale band texture cannot establish tiny emblem/text detail; do not invent one. Actual source alpha250..255 is retained under visible-alpha-v1, with continuous painted backing.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single broad-faced male military bust with short dense black hair brushed upward/backward in a low rounded wave, shorter sides with slight gray temple strokes, and distinct dark eyebrows. Upper lip and chin are smooth with no separate moustache or beard; no hat or glasses. Almost frontal upright head, near-forward gaze, closed lips and a solemn neutral expression. Dark olive-gray military tunic with a closed high standing collar, two rectangular gold collar tabs bearing tiny dark ornamental marks, a round gold center-front button just below the collar, and short shoulder straps with small gold buttons near the outer edges. Preserve the paired collar tabs and their broad placement, shoulder straps, closure and neck contact. Chest/shoulders are cropped by bottom and sides while hair remains within the canvas. Soft upper/front light and shadow under the chin, pale cream-gray painted backing with darker lower sides filling the whole rectangle. No card frame, loose note, exterior cutout or writing. Exact156x210 original and full nearest6 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: the collar-tab interior motifs and small shoulder buttons are too tiny for exact symbols or fine ornament to be identified; preserve visible gold groups without inventing readable designs. Actual source alpha249..255 retained under visible-alpha-v1, with no visibly missing backing.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single slender-faced male military bust with strongly receding short dark brown-gray hair swept straight back, gray streaks at the center/crown and sides, and thin dark angled brows. Smooth upper lip and chin without a separate moustache or beard; no hat or eyewear. Frontal upright head and near-forward gaze, closed lips and a reserved serious expression. Dark gray-green tunic with a closed high standing collar, paired red rectangular collar patches with gold edging and small pale-gold interior mark groups, red shoulder straps with gold buttons near their outer ends, and one round gold center-front button below the collar. Preserve the closed front, paired colored patches, shoulder layout and collar contact. Upper chest/shoulders are cut by the bottom/side edges; the receding hair remains within the canvas. Soft upper/front light, brighter forehead and screen-right cheek, darker lower neck and screen-left face. Pale cream-gray painted backing becomes gray toward the bottom and fills the complete rectangular canvas. No frame, note, exterior cutout or added writing. Exact156x210 original and full nearest6 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: tiny gold mark groups on collar patches and shoulder buttons do not establish exact symbols, lettering or rank counts. Actual source alpha230..255 is retained under visible-alpha-v1 without relabeling it255; the full painted backdrop remains visually continuous.
